evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We present OmicsBench, a long-horizon, multi-turn bioinformatics benchmark for AI agents.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Computational biologists increasingly delegate substantial analyses to AI agents in long-horizon, multi-turn sessions, yet most benchmarks of agents' bioinformatics capabilities pose a single short task with a single-shot prompt.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Because deterministic scoring gives no qualitative account of how an agent failed, we also introduce an unsupervised failure mode discovery pipeline that describes, embeds, and clusters agents' failed attempts to surface emergent failure modes.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across 12 models on three harnesses, the slowest agent averages 3.6 hours per task, and no combination comes near saturating the benchmark, with mean scores of 0.43 to 0.57 out of a possible 1 without in-context feedback and 0.54 to 0.67 with it.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: Each of its 97 tasks links dependent subtasks into a directed acyclic graph, for 662 underlying subtasks in all.
